scientific_question: At the five frozen native exponential fits, how do local Jacobian conditioning, parameter compensation, denominator geometry and held-out linearized sensitivity vary across distance groups, and how does this differ from prediction accuracy?
analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc local-linearization and denominator diagnostics at five frozen native fits; no refitting or new experiment

fold_rule.assignment_rule: Use np.isin on each frozen unique-distance list; every repeated observation remains on the same side and in the original point order
fold_rule.frozen_fit_rule: Use native_parameters and training_rss from each frozen fold exactly; no curve_fit call, parameter update or holdout change is permitted
fold_rule.test_metric_rule: Recomputed native_test_metrics must exactly reproduce the frozen metric dictionary

jacobian_rule.singular_rule: Any zero or non-finite denominator or Jacobian is retained as a failure; no limit substitution or parameter repair

denominator_rule.train_and_test: Record minimum absolute denominator separately on training and held-out observations and minimum over all observations
denominator_rule.pole: When b3 is nonzero, record pole x=-b2/b3 and whether it lies inside the observed closed range [0.5,6.0]; otherwise retain a missing pole and failed diagnostic
denominator_rule.interpretation: Denominator and pole geometry are descriptive native-model diagnostics, not transferred rational certificates or global safety proofs

local_rule.column_scaling: Divide each Jacobian column by its Euclidean norm; require finite nonzero norms
local_rule.numerical_rank: Count scaled singular values greater than rank_tolerance; preserve rank deficiency rather than forcing rank three
local_rule.sigma2: training_RSS/(train_count-3), using the frozen fold-specific degrees of freedom [154,157,160,188,182]
local_rule.standard_errors: sqrt(diag(covariance)); local linearized standard errors only
local_rule.interpretation: Local linearization at each frozen fit; rank, conditioning, standard errors and sensitivity do not prove global structural identifiability or calibrated uncertainty

parameter_stability_rule.statistics: For each parameter across five frozen fits, record minimum, maximum, median, range and per-fold local standard errors
parameter_stability_rule.comparison: Report raw parameter values and native RMSE side by side; do not collapse them into a single stability score
parameter_stability_rule.prediction_stability_scope: Lower held-out RMSE does not imply unique, invariant or physically endogenous parameters

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生Chwirut1原生参数可识别性_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning, new starts, new fold assignments or new parameter values
No conversion of local Jacobians, ranks, covariances or delta-method sensitivity into global identifiability or calibrated intervals
No transfer of rational denominator, ellipsoid, box or continuous-safety claims to the native exponential model
No claim that lower held-out RMSE proves unique, invariant or physically endogenous parameters
No description of Chwirut1 as independent of the Chwirut2 study or native model family
No hiding of rank deficiency, non-finite values, failed variance estimates, denominator poles or fold-level parameter variation
